sampling: Exact1928canonical action-selection training-cohort checkpoints; not uniform10Hz, all-match time or a time-weighted estimate.
model_parameters: Full-data production carry dispersion; no folded-mixture values.
aggregation: Checkpoint-weighted means; parent counts and medians accompany them. Whole-team-possession bootstrap uncertainty.
temporal: Actual checkpoint BCOS by team, half and carrier-origin third; centred 5-minute means for descriptive smoothing.
temporal_windows: Raw checkpoints retained; rolling means use all available checkpoints in a centred five-minute window.
grid_selection: Same 10x6 display cells as production xT; every occupied cell is shown, including low-support cells.
